GemBook Look Tuner

Look tuner · round brilliant

Each layer below sits on the traced light of the approved round brilliant. Turn layers on and off, change their color, blend mode and opacity, and dial in the look per color. Save a look to keep it, and send it to Claude.

The tuner needs its script to run. If this message stays, open the file in a web browser such as Safari, Chrome, Edge or Firefox; a file preview or an email viewer does not run it. On a phone, open a link to the tuner rather than the file.
Screens differ, so set the scale once: lay a ruler on the screen and drag until the bar is exactly 50 mm long.

Saves this gem at its actual size on a transparent background, for digital use or your own print projects. Colors are screen colors (print-simulated when Print simulation is on), not a press file.

    What this tool does not establish: how the gem prints. Print simulation passes the screen through the provisional output profile (Q-11); only a press proof settles color. The traced layers come from a model of the round brilliant, not from photographs, and only the round brilliant is traced so far. Looks saved here are proposals until JC approves a distribution into the build (D-020).
